In which French town was the 52nd G7 summit held in June 2026?

[52nd G7 summit] The 52nd G7 Summit was an annual summit of the G7 held from 15 to 17 June 2026 in Évian-les-Bains, Haute-Savoie, France. Évian-les-Bains previously hosted the 29th G8 summit in 2003. The 2026 summit therefore makes Évian the first French town to host a G7 or G8 leaders' summit twice. At the summit, leaders issued joint statements on Ukraine, the Middle East, critical minerals and global economic imbalances, among other issues.

The 52nd G7 summit was held in Évian-les-Bains, France. 

FINAL: Évian-les-Bains
